prior_artifact_trust.why: The prior run declares VEDAGRAPH_CANONICAL_GRAPH_2026_09_15, a 108,779-node graph. This one holds 116,838 after Wave 3, the attribution census and M8. The owner's condition for trusting an old pool or score is hash-identical inputs, and these are not.

R1_LEMMA_TFIDF.runtime: the Rigvedic morphological layer, which covers one corpus of four

R3_TRANSLATION_TFIDF.runtime: excluded by the confound rule, not by availability

R7_E5_TRANSLATION.runtime: multilingual-e5-small via onnxruntime, and confounded regardless

control.name: C_LEXICAL_CHAR4
control.definition: Jaccard over character 4-grams of accent-stripped NFC Sanskrit primary text. No model, no translation channel.
control.reproduction_note: This is a re-implementation, not a reproduction. 6 of 370 gold pairs match the stored C_LEXICAL_CHAR4 exactly and 292 fall within 0.05; using the unaccented PARALLEL_TEXT instead gives 7 and 281, so the text role is not the difference. The prior formulation was probably cosine over term-frequency vectors rather than Jaccard over gram sets. No prior number is therefore carried forward -- the AUC below is measured here, on the current canonical corpus, and is the baseline a candidate must beat.

control_evaluation.adjudication_caveat: The gold labels were produced by an LLM adjudicator, and 162 of 486 pairs were left UNADJUDICATED_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED. This is not a human gold standard and is not reported as one.

candidate_pool.recall_note: The prior pool's recall against the corpus product was measured at about 0.0079. No new pool is generated here: a pool is only worth building for a representation that can be evaluated, and none can.

translation_confounds_excluded.how: By excluding the translation channel entirely rather than filtering it. The control reads Sanskrit, so a reused rendering cannot reach it.

predicate_semantics_preserved.SAME_CONTENT: kept distinct; not collapsed into topical similarity
predicate_semantics_preserved.SHARED_PHRASING_ONLY: WITHHELD. The prior run adjudicated 8 pairs into this class out of 486, and the owner's established finding is that its boundary was not reproducible enough to carry assertion authority. 8 labels cannot establish one.
predicate_semantics_preserved.GENERIC_TOPICAL_SIMILARITY: not a predicate in this ontology and not created as one

refusal_reasons: No embedding runtime in this checkout (onnxruntime, transformers and sentence_transformers all absent, no .onnx file), so every semantic representation the prior run evaluated is uncomputable here. A representation that cannot be computed cannot be shown to add value over the control.

The owner's established finding is that the character 4-gram control previously beat every semantic candidate. With no semantic candidate computable, that finding stands unchallenged rather than retested.
Importing the prior artifact is barred: its declared graph snapshot is a 108,779-node graph and this one holds 116,838. The inputs are not hash-identical.
control_is_the_baseline: AUC 0.7541 over 279 adjudicated pairs (dev 0.7742, test 0.7356), measured on the current canonical corpus with no model and no translation channel. A semantic representation has to beat this on the same split to be worth importing.
what_would_change_it: An embedding runtime in the checkout, plus adjudication capacity for the 162 unadjudicated gold pairs, would make a real comparison possible. The control is already reproducible from canonical inputs, so it is the baseline any candidate must beat on the same dev/test split.
